system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

> how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- Following the merger's effective time, Energen's common stock ceased to fulfill NYSE
  listing requirements and was removed from listing; Energen's obligation to file
  periodic reports with the SEC under the Exchange Act ended at that point. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-339277, 8-K dated 2018-11-29 (Item 3.01)]
- The acquirer subsequently filed a Form 15-12B to formally terminate registration of
  Energen's common stock. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-346260, Form 15-12B]
- No Form 10-K or other periodic report has been filed by Energen Corporation (CIK
  0000277595) since its final annual report covering fiscal year 2017; a search of the
  registrant's SEC filing history shows no subsequent 10-K, 20-F, or comparable annual
  report. [SRC: SEC accession 0000277595-18-000014, Form 10-K (FY2017, filed 2018-02-28) — last annual report on file]

## Acquirer's subsequent disclosure of the acquired business (feasibility-relevant)
- The acquirer, Diamondback Energy, Inc., does not report segment-level or
  business-unit-level financial results for the acquired Energen operations in its own
  subsequent annual reports; a full-text check of Diamondback's Form 10-K for fiscal
  year 2021 (filed within the outcome window) found no discussion of "Energen" as a
  distinguishable ongoing business unit, and the sole reference to "Energen" in that
  filing concerns Diamondback's 2021 redemption of senior notes that had originally been
  issued by Energen and assumed in the merger — a financing-history note, not a
  business-performance disclosure. [SRC: SEC accession 0001539838-22-000008, Form 10-K (FY2021)]
- No separate divestiture, impairment, or discontinued-operations disclosure specific to
  the acquired Energen assets was located in Diamondback's fiscal-year-2021 Form 10-K;
  the acquired Permian Basin assets appear to have been fully consolidated into
  Diamondback's single reporting entity without business-unit-level public disclosure. [SRC: SEC accession 0001539838-22-000008, Form 10-K (FY2021)]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable
- Contemporaneous (2018-era) acquirer press materials described expected cost and
  operating synergies from combining the two companies' adjacent Permian Basin
  acreage, but these are forward-looking, pre-closing estimates rather than a realized
  3-5-year outcome record, and no primary filing within the outcome window quantifies
  whether those estimates were achieved for the specific acquired assets; this item is
  recorded as [UNVERIFIED] for outcome purposes. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because Energen was absorbed whole into its acquirer and deregistered under the
  Exchange Act shortly after closing, there is no public, business-unit-level 3-5-year
  outcome record for the acquired operations: Energen itself filed no further periodic
  reports, and the acquirer's own subsequent Form 10-K filings within the outcome window
  do not separately disclose the acquired business's financial or operating trajectory,
  reporting it as part of a single consolidated entity. The realized outcome for this
  case is therefore not publicly observable at the business-unit level and is coded
  uncertain rather than inferred from the acquirer's consolidated results. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-339277, 8-K dated 2018-11-29] [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-346260, Form 15-12B] [SRC: SEC accession 0001539838-22-000008, Form 10-K (FY2021)]

[SLICE END]
